Kforce has a client in Houston, TX with a need for a Senior Cloud/Full-Stack Engineer for a contract hybrid role.

Duties Include:
 
  Lead the design, development, and optimization of modern cloud-native applications on Microsoft Azure 
  Work across the stack using ReactJS and C#/.NET to build scalable, secure solutions, implement Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines, and deliver reliable data access using SQL and related technologies 
  Help drive innovation through Azure AI services and application modernization 
  Collaborate with business and engineering teams to define cloud and application architecture on Azure 
  Design, develop, and maintain full-stack applications using ReactJS or similar JavaScript frameworks and C#/.NET 
  Build RESTful APIs and microservices supporting cloud applications and integrations 
  Develop modular, highly available, secure, and scalable cloud-native applications 
  Lead AI-enabled solutions leveraging Microsoft Azure AI services, including pre-built AI capabilities and custom ML models 
  Develop, test, and optimize code and data pipelines for AI and data-driven applications 
  Build and maintain Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines for automated builds, testing, and deployments 
  Design and optimize database schemas and SQL queries for secure, reliable, high-performance data access 
  Drive cloud security, compliance, governance, coding standards, testing, and deployment best practices 
 
 
  Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field 
  Minimum of 3+ years of hands-on experience with one or more major cloud platforms (Azure required; AWS and/or GCP preferred) 
  Experience designing, building, and maintaining microservices and containerized solutions using Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift, or similar 
  Extensive working knowledge of Microsoft Azure (PaaS, IaaS, and platform services) is required; Experience with GCP or AWS is a plus 
  Strong full-stack development experience with: Front end: ReactJS (preferred) or similar modern JavaScript framework; Back end: C#/.NET for building APIs, services, and integrations 
  Strong experience building scalable cloud-native applications on Azure 
  Hands-on Azure DevOps CI/CD or GitLab experience 
  Strong ReactJS, C#/.NET, SQL, REST API, and microservices experience 
  Experience with relational databases; NoSQL knowledge is a plus 
  Experience with scripting and automation using C# and/or Python 
  Familiarity with Azure AI services and ML solutions 
  Industry certifications (e.g., Azure, AWS, GCP, CNCF/Kubernetes) are desired but not required if you have strong demonstrable skills
